name: Daily Rhythm
productFocus: Phase 1: throw a messy day at Rhythm → understand → review → Done → commit, without leaving My Day
notes: Phase 1 voice flow: keeps voice on My Day, adds visible Idle/Listening/Understanding/Review/Done states, stages schedule changes until Done, preserves the spoken draft when the user interrupts before Done, rolls back partial changes when clarification is needed, and keeps long results compact.
